sloka: इति ब्रुवन्तं काकुत्स्थं ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदां वरः ।अब्रवीच्छृणु मे राम सत्यं सत्यपराक्रम ।। ६.१२०.१३ ।।
transliteration: iti bruvantaṁ kākutsthaṁ brahmā brahmavidāṁ varaḥ ।abravīcchṛṇu me rāma satyaṁ satyaparākrama ।। 6.120.13 ।।

translations.english: "You are the divine self, glorious Narayana himself, wielder of discus. You are having a single tusk and a divine boar, knower of past and present."
